title: boundary_from_content uses SmimeError::Other instead of MalformedInput for collision
description: sign.rs line 351: when the derived boundary appears in content, Err(SmimeError::Other(...)) is returned. This is a content-structural constraint violation (RFC 2046 §5.1.1 MIME boundary collision), not a generic 'other' error. Callers cannot distinguish this from unrelated runtime errors using SmimeError::Other. MalformedInput is the semantically correct variant (the input MIME is malformed for this operation). Scenario: a caller that wants to present a meaningful error to the user, or retry with different content, cannot do so without string-matching the error message.
close_reason: Fixed: boundary_from_content now returns MalformedInput instead of Other for collision error.
